raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: fatpack
  version: "0.7.8"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/fatpack-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 30d8679f5f91c54879da1058357b72ceb1f8b025410eb14fcb3cc69a17299659

build:
  number: 1
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - numpy

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - fatpack
      pip_check: true
      python_version: ${{ python_min }}

about:
  summary: Fatigue analysis in python
  description: |
    The package provides classes and functions for rainflow cycle counting,
    defining endurance curves, mean and compressive stress range correction
    and racetrack filtering. The code example below shows how fatigue damage
    can be calculated.
  license: ISC
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/gunnstein/fatpack
  repository: https://github.com/gunnstein/fatpack

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - gunnstein
    - gbarter
